notes: Mortgage and housing updates from primary public sources.

items.title: August new-home purchase mortgage applications decreased 5.5 percent
items.title_zh: MBA：8 月新建房购房抵押贷款申请同比下降 5.5%
items.summary: MBA’s Builder Application Survey reported that August applications for new-home purchases fell 5.5% year over year and 6% from July, before seasonal adjustment. MBA estimated new single-family home sales at a 664,000 seasonally adjusted annual rate; that is an MBA estimate, not the Census Bureau’s official release.
items.summary_zh: MBA 的建商申请调查显示，8 月新建房购房抵押贷款申请同比下降 5.5%、较 7 月下降 6%（未季调）。MBA 估算新建独栋房销售的季调年率为 66.4 万套；这是基于其调查的估算，不是美国人口普查局的官方发布。

items.title: Fannie Mae publishes September 2026 Economic and Housing Outlook
items.title_zh: 房利美发布 2026 年 9 月经济与住房展望
items.summary: Fannie Mae’s Economic and Strategic Research Group published its monthly economic and housing outlook, covering current conditions and forecasts for measures including rates, home sales, prices, starts and mortgage originations. The outlook is a forecast, not a lender quote or guarantee.
items.summary_zh: 房利美经济与战略研究组发布月度经济与住房展望，涵盖利率、房屋销售、房价、开工和房贷发放等指标的现状与预测。该展望属于预测，并非贷款机构报价或保证。

items.title: The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate was 6.76%
items.title_zh: 30 年固定房贷全国平均利率为 6.76%
items.summary: Freddie Mac's PMMS reported a 6.76% average, up from 6.71% the week before. The 15-year fixed average was 6.09%.
items.summary_zh: Freddie Mac 的 PMMS 显示，30 年固定房贷平均利率为 6.76%，高于前一周的 6.71%；15 年固定房贷平均利率为 6.09%。

items.title: HUD takes action to make housing more affordable
items.title_zh: HUD 调整公平住房法相关指引，称将降低住房建设成本
items.summary: HUD rescinded prior guidance on the Fair Housing Act statute of limitations for design and construction claims. The agency said the change is intended to reduce unnecessary liability and costs passed on to homebuyers and renters.
items.summary_zh: HUD 撤销了关于《公平住房法》设计和施工索赔诉讼时效的既有指引。该机构表示，此举旨在减少不必要的责任与可能转嫁给购房者和租房者的成本。

items.title: FHFA reports second-quarter U.S. home price growth of 2.1% year over year
items.title_zh: FHFA：美国二季度房价同比上涨 2.1%
items.summary: The Q2 report shows national prices up 2.1% year over year and 0.3% quarter over quarter.
items.summary_zh: FHFA 二季度报告显示，全美房价同比上涨 2.1%、环比上涨 0.3%；经季节调整的 6 月月度指数与 5 月持平。

items.title: Fannie Mae releases its August housing forecast
items.title_zh: Fannie Mae 发布 8 月住房预测
items.summary: The August forecast covers home sales, starts, mortgage rates and originations.
items.summary_zh: 8 月预测列出了住房销售、开工、房贷利率和贷款发放量的预期。

items.title: HUD announced 14 FHA single-family policy changes
items.title_zh: HUD 公布 14 项 FHA 单户住房政策调整
items.summary: HUD said the changes cover appraisal reviews, Limited 203(k), lender quality control, and closing documents, with the goal of reducing duplicate requirements and process costs.
items.summary_zh: HUD 表示，新调整涉及评估复核、Limited 203(k)、贷款机构质量控制和部分交割文件，目标是减少重复要求并降低 FHA 贷款流程成本。
